title: message not for important failures
rule: Message is not for important failures — Ant Message = top-centered, auto-dismiss (default 3s), non-blocking. Important failure → dialog with the reason. Do not use a lightweight prompt for important failure.
pass_when: Important failure uses a dialog with the reason. Lightweight Message is not used for that failure.
fail_when: Important failure only as a 3s top Message.
overview: Ant Message is lightweight auto-dismiss feedback, not for important failures.
apply_when: Choosing feedback after a failure that needs a clear reason.
not_when: Transient success or low-stakes status that can auto-dismiss.
agent_hint: Put important failures in a dialog with the reason, not Message.
description: Ant Message is top-centered, non-blocking, and auto-dismisses (default about three seconds). Important failures need a dialog that states the reason so the user can act; a fleeting Message alone is the wrong vehicle. Use this when severity is high enough that losing the copy on dismiss would leave them stuck — not for ordinary transient status.
do_not_claim: Spectrum toast ≥5s as a house winner over 3s; WCAG interruptions.
